d:
An encouraging number with inspiring vocals by Udit Narayan and Alka Yagnik supported by Sukhwinder Singh & Srinivas make you want to get up and conquer the world! Pump up yourself with this song just as Aamir Khan and Gracy Singh do in Mitwa from the film Lagaan (2001).
Song Name - Mitwa
Movie - Lagaan
Singer - Alka Yagnik, Udit Narayan, Sukhwinder Singh & Srinivas
Composer - A.R. Rahman
Lyricist - Javed Akhtar
Music Label - Sony Music Entertainment India Pvt. Ltd.
